name: Comprehensive LLD Case Studies: Parking Lot & Library Management
subject: Object-Oriented Programming Systems

mcqs.question: Which design pattern is best suited for calculating parking fees under varying rate models (hourly, flat, discount)?
mcqs.explanation: The Strategy pattern encapsulates fee calculation algorithms, allowing the parking lot to switch fee structures (e.g. weekday vs holiday rates) without modifying payment code.

mcqs.question: In a multi-threaded parking lot system, what is the best strategy to prevent two concurrent entry gates from assigning the same parking spot?
options: Disable multi-threading and run on a single core CPU
Use fine-grained mutex locks or atomic operations around the spot reservation logic
Assign spots randomly without checking availability
Let both park and resolve collision after cars reach the spot
mcqs.explanation: Thread synchronization via mutexes or lock-free atomic spot availability flags prevents race conditions and duplicate spot allocation.
